_comment: Behavioral attribute definitions: the exact lexicons, regexes and parameters computing the per-response measurement y_a. Lexicon-based attributes reference the other banks (hedges.json, sycophancy.json, confidence.json) so a single source defines each attribute.

verbosity_matched.formula: 1 - unique_ngrams/total_ngrams (0 if < 20 tokens); repetition ratio, higher = more redundant

sycophancy_surface.scope: openers scanned in first 200 chars, closers in last 200
